scope: Own-source endpoint regressions/gates and bounded own-native D003/file observations; separate historical failures. No vendor material or compiled artifacts.
literal_normalization: Text bytes replace checkout root with ROOT, then account home with HOME; per-file counts/hashes below. Nothing else is altered. Images and saved documents retain exact bytes.
embedded_hash_qualification: Embedded frozen original hashes continue to identify original bytes. Public derivative hashes below identify normalized public bytes; no embedded hash/pending wording/count was repaired.
lifecycle_qualification: First Quit was followed by an AX query returning a new empty process, not App quit error. Second PID3213 was independently bound and used for the predeclared reopen; automatic observer launch is an inference, no third launch occurred. Owned PIDs2719/3213 were absent afterward. No compliant full-workflow claim.
disk_write_qualification: Native saves, own working project, autosave and recovery writes remain retained; no zero-disk-writes claim.
historical_qualification: E001/D001/D002 remain closed failures at their original commits. D002 trace47 artifacts are historical timing-sensitive diagnostics only and do not require or authorize trace47 in shipping ancestry.
